idea-plugin.name: Better Logcat
idea-plugin.description:
A modern Logcat tool window for Android Studio. It keeps the filter syntax you know and fixes what gets in the way: multi-line messages, long JSON, noisy tags, and crashes that scroll away.

Problems that stay

  • Problems panel: crashes, ANRs, exceptions, StrictMode violations and warnings, grouped with counts, per session.
  • Kept after Clear and IDE restarts until you delete them. Frame drop chart from Choreographer.
  • Gutter icons with quick actions, Copy as Issue (Markdown), native crash symbolizing, crash notifications.

Reading and filtering

  • Stack traces and chunked bodies (Ktor, OkHttp) stay one entry. JSON is detected, colored and pretty printed.
  • Studio-style search terms with autocomplete: package:mine, tag:, -tag:, level:, is:crash, age:, context:N.
  • Favorites and history with match counts. Find bar that does not change the filter.
  • Tags panel as a tree: show or hide with checkboxes, drag tags together into groups, tag descriptions.
  • Keyword highlights and presets for OkHttp, Ktor and Retrofit. Clickable stack frames. R8 retrace.

Working with entries

  • Block selection, smart copy, free text selection in any cell.
  • Bookmarks that survive Clear and restarts. Network panel with Copy as cURL. Compare two entries.
  • Export, open a saved log, or compare the log with a saved file.

Devices and layout

  • Tabs and split panes, each with its own device and filter.
  • Pair devices over Wi-Fi. Screenshots and screen recordings.
Open the "Better Logcat" tool window. Everything stays on your machine: the plugin sends nothing over the network. Open source (Apache 2.0): github.com/melihaksoy/BetterLogcat.
